events.name: Bash
events.head: Start a local dev server and run the Pro probe against the live mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; (PORT=4430 nohup npx next dev -p 4430 >/tmp/t087-dev.log 2>&1 &); BASE=https://adisuja.github.io PREFIX=/tantra-workshop-live/site node scripts/probe-pro.mjs >/tmp/t087-probe-pro.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; grep -c '^PASS' /tmp/t087-probe-pro.log; grep -E '^FAIL|n8n|checkout start' /tmp/t087-probe-pro.log | cut -c1-200; tail -2 /tmp/t087-probe-pro.log | cut -c1-200; tail -3 /tmp/t087-dev.log
